basis: Inherited cardiac repolarization disorder; extracardiac damage is not common across the umbrella.
Immune-mediated eosinophilic inflammation of lung tissue; no common extrapulmonary damage defines this condition.
Ornithine metabolism defect causing progressive chorioretinal degeneration; aminoaciduria alone does not establish renal damage; hearing loss is under 30%.
Genetic glomerular disease with proteinuria and progressive kidney failure; other PAX2-associated phenotypes are not established for this concept.
Pentose phosphate defect with cirrhosis and cytopenias in 80-99%; renal abnormalities in 30-79%. Cardiac defects are generally under 30%; skin changes omitted at cap.
Lysosomal storage disorders defined here by skeletal dysplasia; additional organ damage varies across the constituent diseases.
Disease of the glossopharyngeal peripheral cranial nerve; impaired swallowing does not itself establish gastrointestinal tissue damage.
Epileptic neurodevelopmental disorder with intellectual disability and cerebral abnormalities; hypotonia does not establish primary muscle damage.
Defining nephropathy and microcephalic brain disease; congenital hypothyroidism occurs in 3/3 reported patients. Arachnodactyly alone does not establish locomotor damage.
Developmental impairment and defining craniofacial/skeletal abnormalities; cardiac defects in single-patient annotations do not establish a population frequency of 30%.
Inherited vitreoretinal disease; hearing loss and developmental impairment vary between Norrie disease and other NDP phenotypes, with no umbrella frequency established.
Congenital heart disease defines the Noonan phenotype; strabismus affects 3/9 patients (~33%). Reported neurodevelopmental and skeletal abnormalities individually fall below 30%.
Hereditary neoplastic susceptibility targets the colon and rectum; susceptibility does not imply an existing tumour or additional organ damage.
Immune dysregulation directly causes colitis in 4/6 and gastritis in 2/6. Rash alone does not establish skin damage; lymphoma and infections are separate diseases.
Eosinophilic inflammatory infiltration of lung tissue; tissue eosinophils do not by themselves establish a blood or marrow disorder.
CRYGC-related cataract directly affects the ocular lens; associated visual abnormalities remain within the ocular axis.
Congenital distal joint contractures and foot deformities define the disorder; no additional organ damage is established.
Primary malignancy of breast tissue, which has no axis; metastatic organ involvement is not implied.
Disorder of thyroid calcitonin secretion, classified under thyroid gland disease.
POMT1 dystroglycanopathy combines defective O-glycosylation, muscular dystrophy and characteristic neurodevelopmental disease; ocular damage varies by subtype.
Nonsyndromic sensorineural hearing loss in 8/8 patients; retinal disease associated with other PCDH15 phenotypes is not part of this concept.
Autoinflammatory interferonopathy; damaging AGS-like encephalopathy is the predominant RNASEH2A phenotype (>30%). Other organ involvement is insufficiently established.
Destructive neuropathic joint degeneration; the causative neurologic disorder is a separate underlying disease.
Chronic gonococcal infection supplies the mechanism axis; seminal vesicles are reproductive organs, and urinary tract involvement is not implied.
Defining Duane ocular motility disorder and radial-ray limb malformations; renal, cardiac and hearing involvement are not established at ≥30% for this deletion subtype.
